features.name: Lexical dispatch properties in receiver and ordinary lambdas
features.scope: After nearer extension receivers fail, bare property lookup uses the retained lexical dispatch receiver. Ordinary callbacks, constructor initialization, nested receiver precedence, labeled this and nearest unqualified this execute against both compilers.

features.name: Literal binary Compose Unit callbacks with exact capture classification
features.scope: Canonical Kotlin metadata and a matching physical Function2<Composer,Integer,Unit> signature enable a literal zero-argument Unit callback. The actual pinned runtime wrapper handles restart groups, tracking and restart callbacks; generated bodies preserve skip, hidden-parameter and trace behavior. Checked IR removes unused implicit receiver captures, preserving cached stateless callback identity.
